ALG-001.description: Witness identity is intensional and relational. Two semantic witnesses are identical if they represent the same relational mapping in context C.
ALG-001.multiplicity_allowed: Yes, distinct concrete realizations (L2) can correspond to one semantic witness (L1).

ALG-003.compatibility_premise: Composition w1 ∘ w2 requires matching relational domains in context C.
ALG-003.partiality: Composition is partial and preserves context C.

ALG-004.partiality: Partial. Transport can fail even when type preservation (OBL-D-001C) succeeds.
ALG-004.construction: Transport constructs a new target witness w' from source witness w.

ALG-005.description: Restricting a witness from context C to a subset context C' is monotone and valid if Relation_C restricts to Relation_C'.

ALG-006.description: Unqualified context extension of witnesses is generally invalid because relation constraints can tighten in broader contexts.

ALG-007.description: A single semantic witness can have multiple realizations (trace certificates, Lean proof terms). One realization can encode multiple witnesses if it spans multiple relations.

ALG-008.description: Compatibility is directional and trace-specific, representing directed execution records.

ALG-009.description: Semantic collapse occurs when the required witness mapping has no valid realization. Absence of realization indicates collapse, not merely insufficient evidence, under closed-world assumptions.
